card.name: Small words in economic and date comparisons
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as in, to, the, is or an opening bracket, in general-web text about economic growth, years and statistics, often just before a year, date range or figure.

modes.label: Preposition before a year or period
modes.description: The word in or to sits just before a date, year range or time period.

modes.label: Linking word in growth comparisons
modes.description: A small word appears in a sentence comparing economic or population figures over time.
modes.example: far higher than<< the>> current model.

modes.label: Space or bracket before a number
modes.description: A blank space or opening bracket right before a figure or year.

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in news-style passages about economies, years and statistics, just before a date or number.
